**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king is exposed and your pieces are active nearby, look for checks that force the king to worse squares. Here, Nh4+ drives White's king to g1, which allows your queen to deliver mate on f2. The knight move also "discovers" (uncovers) an attack from your queen to White's undefended knight—but the mate is faster. Always calculate checks first before capturing loose pieces, because in-between moves often win outright.
